title: The Sphere in Character Models
content: Classic characters from 1930s animation often used a ball for the head or the pelvis.A good source of this style is the 1936 bookCartooning Self-Taughtby Otto Mesmer, which shows heads, hands, and body shapes based on circles or spheres.---ReadCartooning Self-Taughton Archive.orgMore about this book at CartoonSnapEssay by Mel Birnkrant about the Art and Imagery of Comic Characters
